text:
marco: Heads up — internal routing policy change landed in canary gateway. It now injects policy-binding metadata in `X-Route-Bind` header. Python SDK doesn't surface it and TS client still sends the legacy `x-route-id` header. We're seeing quota attribution mismatch in the console. Anyone seeing this?

elaine: saw the console spikes earlier. looks like some requests are being attributed to the default tenant because the pipeline only honors the canonical header. :grimacing:

jen: that's rough. was the header rename intentional? we didn't get a heads-up for client libs.

marco: It was an intentional change to support per-tenant fallback on dedicated pools, but the header rename went out without SDK coordination. We need a compatibility path (shim) or a revert.

samir: options: 1) gateway accepts both headers for 2 weeks + push SDK shims to emit canonical header, 2) revert quickly and plan a coordinated rollout. I prefer shim so customer apps don't break.

jen: estimated SDK effort: py has transport-level header parsing so we can emit canonical header in ~1 day as a patch; ts client uses a fetch wrapper and will need a minor semver bump and docs — ~1-2 days. Go client needs an owner to estimate.

elaine: console/telemetry note — if gateway accepts both headers we should normalize at ingestion to avoid double-counting. We can add a mapping rule `{legacy -> canonical}` in the ingestion transform.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout paused at 8% due to metric drift alert (ID: DRIFT-2026-03).

marco: Proposed plan: enable dual-header support behind a feature-flag in gateway, patch py/ts clients to prefer canonical when present, and add normalization in the telemetry pipeline. Timeline: gateway flag flip tomorrow AM, py patch by EOD today, ts canary update tomorrow afternoon. Go client follow-up. Sound good?

jen: ack — I'll open tickets, assign PRs for py/ts, and draft SDK release notes with a deprecation timeline for the legacy header.

samir: also add an e2e test in infra that simulates header variants and validates console attribution mapping.

marco: thanks — we'll reconvene after gateway flag flip. :thumbsup:
